question: What was the build up play speed class for "Willem II" on 2011/2/22?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT t2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Info AS t1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'Willem II'
  AND SUBSTR(t2.date, 1, 10) = '2011-02-22'
